data.name: TrollFools
data.subtitle: Inject tweaks into installed apps on-device
data.localizedDescription: TrollFools injects tweaks into apps that are already installed, straight on the device: it performs in-place dylib injection with insert_dylib and ChOma, so no computer and no jailbreak is involved. Upstream documents removable system applications, decrypted App Store apps installed through TrollStore, and encrypted App Store apps patched with a bare dynamic library, plus .deb and .zip tweak packages. Written in SwiftUI, and built on ChOma, MachOKit and insert_dylib.
data.versionDescription:
TrollFools 4.4-257 | TrollFools_4.4-257.tipa

允许 Dopamine 被 TrollFools 注入第三方插件，以提供自定义背景、倒计时自动越狱及其他扩展功能。

------

Allows official Dopamine to be injected by TrollFools into third-party plugins to provide custom backgrounds, automatic jailbreak countdowns, and other extended features.

Allows official Dopamine to be injected by TrollFools into third-party plugins to provide custom backgrounds, automatic jailbreak countdowns, and other extended features.

compatibility.notes: Official .tipa from the project's GitHub releases - a .tipa is byte-identical to an .ipa, so AltStore, SideStore, Feather and ESign install it after re-signing it with your certificate. The injection itself only works where TrollStore exists (upstream states iOS 14.0 - 17.0), so on newer firmware the app installs but cannot patch anything.
